name: hcapp_setHasherBlock
description: Blocks (1) or unblocks (0) another hasher for the caller (E9.F1.S16): MERGE on HC.HasherFriendMap (UserId = caller, Friend_UserId = target) setting Ignore. Unblock keeps the row with Ignore = 0. Every chat reader hides the blocked hasher's messages from the caller, no push from them reaches the caller, unread counts leave them out. Directional; the blocked hasher is told nothing. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 125); no permission gate — any signed-in hasher manages their own block list. Target must exist with Removed = 0, must not be the caller, and @blocked must be 0 or 1 (else 1985 / errorType 2). Returns the caller's refreshed blocked list (the shape of hcapp_getBlockedHashers).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID (default NULL; ValidateAppAuth refuses NULL).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL; ValidateAppAuth refuses NULL.

parameters.name: targetPublicHasherId
parameters.description: The other hasher's PUBLIC id (chat authorId). Resolved to HC.Hasher.id with Removed = 0. Default NULL → 1985 'That hasher could not be found.'

parameters.name: blocked
parameters.description: 1 block, 0 unblock (default 1). Any other value → 1985 / errorType 2.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Auth failure ONLY (ValidateAppAuth): a single rowset with the error detail — NO success/errorCode/errorType envelope precedes it.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Bad request (1985/2: target not found or removed, target = caller, @blocked not 0/1) or unhandled (1986/5). Followed by ErrorDetail at index 1.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Follows ErrorEnvelope. Same columns as AuthErrorDetail.

rowsets.name: BlockedHashers
rowsets.description: Success only, after the envelope: the caller's blocked hashers (Ignore = 1), newest block first.

columns.name: PublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) — UPPERCASE text; clients must lowercase on arrival (HcId).

columns.name: BlockedAt
columns.description: HasherFriendMap.updatedAt (DATETIMEOFFSET(7) NOT NULL, added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-29_hasher_block.sql; missing from the stale table file). Ordered newest first.

sideEffects: MERGE HC.HasherFriendMap WITH (HOLDLOCK) on (UserId, Friend_UserId): matched → SET Ignore = @blocked, updatedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(); not matched → INSERT (UserId, Friend_UserId, Ignore). One transaction.
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog ('Hasher blocked' / 'Hasher unblocked', StrParam1 = caller, Data = 'target=<id>').
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on auth failure (ValidateAppAuth), bad request (line 58) and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.issue: Auth-failure rowset shape differs from every other error path
codeSmells.detail: Lines 45-50 return only the error-detail rowset, with no success/errorCode/errorType envelope; the validation (lines 62-67) and CATCH (lines 104-108) paths return envelope + detail. A client that reads rowset 0 for 'success' sees errorId there instead on an auth failure.

codeSmells.issue: Uppercase id in a client rowset
codeSmells.detail: Line 91 returns UPPER(CAST(PublicHasherId ...)). The app lowercases at the door (lowerGuidsInPlace), but the UPPER is deliberate work in the wrong direction (CLAUDE.md 'Ids are lowercase').

codeSmells.issue: Validation uses 'Bad block request' for three different causes
codeSmells.detail: Line 55 folds not-found, self-block and bad @blocked into one code 1985; the user message (line 65) says 'could not be found' when @blocked is out of range.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
